content:
I finally finished Vigil by George Saunders today. Feels like I’ve been reading it for a long time. Even though it took me longer than expected to read it, I liked it. Didn’t love it, but liked it enough to finish it.

I think I’d like to finish Dungeon Crawler Carl and start reading The Topeka School, which a friend generously surprised me with after a conversation about Transcription, which is one of the best books I’ve read in a while.
